answer: The network should carry an immune memory. Every settled fraud adds a signature - funding shape, timing cadence, attestation rhythm - to a public pattern library, and each newborn identity is scored against the archived archetypes at birth. Jade takes ages to form; a dune is built in an afternoon, and accounts matching old cons start sandboxed with tiny quotas until they differentiate, while genuine variety clears instantly and finds safe harbor. Attackers must invent new fraud shapes each wave, paying originality prices their margins cannot absorb - memory turns each caught clone into armor.
